setup: The hv-01 Harvester lab (Kube-OVN v1.16.2) with KubeVirt: custom VPCs vpc-onewater and vpc-twowater, each with one subnet attached through a kube-ovn NetworkAttachmentDefinition (onewater, twowater), plus the external underlay. VM test-2-nics-2-vpc has one NIC in each VPC; vm-onewater, vm-2 and vm-twowater have one NIC in theirs; the other VMs use the default bridge network. No NB NAT rows.
